name: NHTSA
sub: Proposed removing brake-pedal mandates for ADS-only vehicles
about: Primary U.S. vehicle-safety regulator for automated vehicles, FMVSS compliance, recalls, investigations, SGO crash reporting, and exemption petitions.
model: Federal motor vehicle safety standards, investigations, recalls, crash reporting, and exemption decisions.
deployment: National; applies to vehicles and ADS/Level 2 ADAS manufacturers operating in the U.S.
metrics: Proposed 2026 changes to rules for driver-control-free AVs and withdrew Biden-era AV framework proposal
signal: NHTSA proposed removing manual brake-pedal requirements for vehicles designed only for ADS operation in June 2026.
